# LAMMPS input script for Mg quenching simulation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data /structures/task_31/heatedsystem_3000_reax.dat

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Initialize velocity
velocity all create 2000.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT quenching
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal
dump 1 all custom 1000 quench.lammpstrj id type x y z
run 20000
undump 1
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NVT relaxation
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 3

# Output final density
variable dens equal density
print "Final_density: ${dens}"

# LAMMPS input script for Al quenching simulation

# Initialization
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Read initial configuration
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/comprehensive/tasks/aluminum_quenching_trial_1/Al.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# Create velocity
velocity all create 2000 12345 dist gaussian

# Define compute for temperature and pressure
compute myTemp all temp
compute myPress all pressure myTemp

# NPT quench from 2000K to 300K
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal
dump 1 all custom 1000 quench.lammpstrj id type x y z vx vy vz
run 20000
undump 1
unfix 1

# NPT relaxation at 300K
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NVT relaxation at 300K
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 3

# Output final density
variable dens equal density
print "Final_density: ${dens}"

units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Read structure
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/quenching/comprehensive/tasks/aluminum_quenching_trial_4/Al.data

# Potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Settings
timestep 0.001
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Heat to initial temperature
velocity all create 2000 12345 dist gaussian
fix 1 all nvt temp 2000 2000 0.1
run 5000
unfix 1

# NPT Quench
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000
unfix 1

# NPT Relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# NVT Equilibration
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 3

print "Final density: $(density) g/cm^3"
